description: Log-only. One line per event recording whether the plugin's userConfig values reached the hook process, and which surface it ran on.

hooks.command: echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) event=SessionStart entrypoint=${CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT:-none} remote=${CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE:-false} tenant=${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_TENANT_ID:-UNSET} key_set=$([ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_ENROLMENT_KEY:-}" ] && echo yes || echo no) key_len=${#CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_ENROLMENT_KEY}" >> /tmp/manifold-env-probe.log

echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) event=UserPromptSubmit entrypoint=${CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT:-none} remote=${CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE:-false} tenant=${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_TENANT_ID:-UNSET} key_set=$([ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_ENROLMENT_KEY:-}" ] && echo yes || echo no) key_len=${#CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_ENROLMENT_KEY}" >> /tmp/manifold-env-probe.log
